exposure: underlying conditions (e.g., congenital heart disease, ventricular septal defect)
outcome: causes of mortality (PAH crisis, total heart failure, multiple organ failure, Eisenmenger syndrome, respiratory failure)
cohort: 54 deceased pregnant women diagnosed with pulmonary hypertension at The Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between May 2009 and February 2022.
finding: Maternal perinatal mortality was high in pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension, with common causes of death including PAH crisis, total heart failure, multiple organ failure, and Eisenmenger syndrome; complications like postpartum hemorrhage, left ventricular dysfunction, multiorgan failure, arrhythmia, gestational diabetes mellitus, and infection were associated with poorer prognosis.
followup_time: until death, with most deaths occurring within 1 week postpartum
